status_note: The five targeted projections (arch lookup/min/identity, lanedMap lifecycle, PIECE and MULTIEQUAL splits through doTrace+apply, INT_MULT zero-mutation rejection) are byte-identical MATCH against the locked 12.0.4 oracle. Seven branches remain uncovered or undefined under LANEDIVIDE-INFRA-RESIDUAL-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: setReplacement returns the pieceMap array start of the first split for a varnode (marked varnodes reuse the existing array, ignoring the requested subset, subflow.cc:3521-3522); getLanedRegister returns a const LanedRegister* shared by pointer identity into lanedMap (Rugra Arc identity); doTrace/apply mutate Funcdata in place only through TransformManager placeholders until apply materializes ops/varnodes; failed doTrace leaves every op/varnode byte unchanged except cleared marks.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: traceForward walks the descend list front-to-back incrementing the iterator before processing each op (subflow.cc:3923-3924); doTrace drains the workList LIFO via pop_back until empty or first failure (subflow.cc:4118-4123); processNextWork runs traceBackward then traceForward; buildStore/buildLoad iterate count 0..numLanes with big-endian lane reordering numLanes-1-count; buildMultiequal creates one input placeholder set per op input (input-major) then one MULTIEQUAL per lane; the Rust comparand snapshots the descend list once before iterating because placeholder creation cannot mutate it.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: bytePos starts at 0 per buildStore/buildLoad and accumulates description.getSize(skipLanes+i) per emitted lane, never resetting inside one build; minLanedSize gates checkForLanedRegister at every newUnique/newUniqueOut/newVarnode/newVarnodeOut, takes the 1000000 sentinel after setLanedRegGenerated and is reset (without clearing lanedMap) by Funcdata::clear; workList grows only from setReplacement of non-free non-constant varnodes.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: lanerecords are ordered ascending by whole size with duplicate-size sizeBitMask merged (architecture.cc:970-974); getLanedRegister binary-searches wholeSize equality and ignores the address (architecture.cc:290-306); lanedMap is keyed by VarnodeData::operator< comparing space index, then offset, then size descending (pcoderaw.hh:67); lane geometry comparisons are exact getBoundary boundary equality via restriction/extension.

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus three verified overlays; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One BfdArchitecture shell per case over immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl (GetStr for the map lifecycle, main_free/hugehelp/main_init for trace cases); no followFlow and no Action pass; one synthetic BlockBasic per trace case; lanerecords replaced in-place with whole sizes 8 (mask 0x4) and 16 (mask 0x110)
analysis_options.placeholder_construction: Each trace case creates one integrated root op (PIECE at end, MULTIEQUAL at begin, INT_MULT at end) with unique outputs and constant inputs, plus SUBPIECE readers with constant offsets 0 and 2; LaneDivide is constructed directly with LaneDescription(4,2) and allowDowncast=false, then doTrace and (on success) apply
analysis_options.case_matrix: arch lookup over merged size records; lanedMap miss/hit/suppress/preserve/clear; PIECE and MULTIEQUAL lane splits through doTrace+apply; INT_MULT default-branch rejection with zero mutation
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.diagnostics: BfdArchitecture initialization diagnostics captured privately and excluded from the target API observation
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw unique-space offsets and process pointer values are omitted. Stable vN/oN encounter labels preserve all aliasing; opcode, SeqNum time/order, parent, create index, size, space index, constant value, def-use, lanedMap storage keys and record identity are byte-compared

observation_schema.format: Five fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.op_projection: Exact block order, opcode, SeqNum time/order, dead state, parent index, output identity and ordered input identities
observation_schema.varnode_projection: First-encounter identity, create index, size, address-space index, constant value, free/input/written flags, defining op and ordered descendant ops
observation_schema.count_projection: block ops, projected varnodes, alive/dead/all bank ops and total Funcdata varnodes
observation_schema.laned_projection: arch record: minimum size, ordered whole sizes, size-16 lookup whole size and bit mask, cross-space record identity, size-12 miss; map record: per-storage space:offset:size with record identity, whole size and bit mask in VarnodeData::operator< order, miss/suppress/preserve/reset/clear deltas
observation_schema.anchor_projection: doTrace result, root mark state after trace, failed-path before==after equality, replaced root dead state and detached output, reader SUBPIECE opcode and input count after apply
observation_schema.preserved: No order, alias, control-flow, identity or count field is normalized; only unique offsets and raw pointers are intentionally absent
